Words fail to fully describe the beauty of its majesty, and mystery. You will see relentlessly spectacular rock formations rise out of mirrored jade-green water. These are pristine places with unique ecosystems that are not yet frequented by the usual tourist crowds. Discerning travelers have long known of the splendid sights of the archipelago, which are not only composed of untouched natural beauty, cultural values, but also have great biodiversity significance.
